arms.notes: Six-agent increment counts CONFIRMED verdicts beyond the rules baseline; single-agent increment counts claimed findings beyond it (no verdicts, not confirmed truth). REFUTED is a model verdict, not an independently labeled FP rate. Missing usage or timing stays null.
